methodology.objective_slop: PR file patches matched AIV hard markers (conflict / AI edit-artifact / attribution).
methodology.merged_control: Merged PRs without those markers; hard fail = false positive for hard gate.
methodology.closed_unmerged_sample: Closed unmerged without markers — population sample, not AI-slop ground truth.
methodology.not_claimed: Closed-unmerged alone does not prove AI authorship (AIP-120 measures volume, not provenance).
